scope: Generic symmetric binary text-pair matching: normalization, lexical similarities, training-only TF-IDF/LSA and unlabeled pair-graph context.
limitations: NFKC/casefold/word-token normalization, no spelling correction or external semantic corpus
Input text limited to512 characters; empty normalized text rejected
LSA dimension must fit training vocabulary/documents; no silent fallback
Graph describes candidate co-occurrence, not labeled equivalence; current training edge excluded
Empty-set Jaccard defined as one, zero-norm LSA cosine as zero
Training/model/calibration and serialized graph validation pending
